description: fixtures/00144: a multi-arrow @spec with swapped arrows passes, because spec checking is caller-side only (FunctionContract::apply, src/compiler2/contract.rs:120-176, never inspects the callee's body). Elixir never reads @spec (typespecs.md:16-18); only Dialyzer does, so this is fz-only. Shape: a definition-side check narrows each arrow's clauses, infers the return, and compares through Types::match_arrow; a mismatch is spec/violation at the arrow span. title: A function's body is checked against its own @spec
